title: Callflow curation and autonomous pager gating for noisy multi-region SLOs
creator: Aisha Gomez
description:
Problem: Over the past 3 months our oncall team has seen ~60% of pages tied to transient inter-region RPC latency spikes that self-resolve within 30–45s. These pages increase fatigue, delay response to real incidents, and correlate with unnecessary failovers during cross-region storms.

Goal: Build a deterministic, auditable pipeline that curates callflows (alert -> notification -> page) for SLO-linked signals, applies context-aware gating (autonomous suppress/hold/escalate decisions), and attaches an automated provisional runbook to each page. The pipeline must preserve safety (no silent failures for true system degradation), be reversible, and instrumented for post-incident analysis.

Scope:
- Alert rule rework for multi-region latency-based SLOs and circuit-breaker state changes
- Callflow curation layer to attach context (recent failover decisions, regional capacity, KV-cache-hit-rates) to a page before escalation
- Pager gating logic (temporal dedupe + severity rescore + transient-hold with automated re-eval) implemented in Ops Orchestrator service
- Auto-attached provisional runbook templates with one-click escalation to human responder
- Telemetry dashboards and experiment harness to validate downstream impact on MTTR and noise rates

Out of scope for this ticket: policy changes to commercial SLOs, long-term staffing model for oncall rotation, implementing a brand new paging provider (we'll integrate with existing PagerDuty/Sentry hooks).
acceptance_criteria: New callflow curation layer enriches 100% of alerts for the three targeted SLOs with region and cache context
Pager gating reduces pages for transient latency alerts by >= 50% during a 2-week canary window without increasing unresolved SLO breaches
Automated provisional runbook is attached to pages and contains steps, safe-mode flags, and rollback commands
Operational playbook and runbook templates reviewed and approved by Oncall leads and SRE manager
Dashboards show pre/post noise, pages/hour, MTTR, and false-positive rate for the canary cohort
changes: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting. Agreed target SLOs: 'inference_p99_latency' global with per-region sub-SLOs; circuit-breaker open-rate monitored as separate SLO-linked signal. Attendees: Aisha, Liam, Priya K., Marco, SRE leads.
2026-02-20: Prototype callflow enrichment implemented in dev: attaches region, recent failover events (last 15m), KV cache eviction rate, rolling pod restarts. Initial schema reviewed (see doc link).

2026-02-25: Engineering review: decided to prefer temporal hold (45s re-eval window) + severity rescore over blind suppression. Trade-off: small delay for true pages vs major noise reduction. Recorded decision in RFC-ops-23.
2026-03-03: Oncall lead feedback: add explicit 'force-page' tag when automated gating may delay customer-visible impact; implemented as 'auto_hold_exempt' in curation metadata.
2026-03-08: Canary plan approved to run in us-west1 and eu-central regions for 2 weeks with staged traffic (10% -> 30% -> 100% of eligible alerts).
decisions: Use temporal dedupe window of 45 seconds for transient latency SLO alerts based on workload distribution analysis (p95 inter-arrival < 10s, spikes typically < 30s)
Severity rescore formula: base_score * (1 + open_circuit_penalty + recent_failover_penalty) where penalties derived from recent failover counts; thresholds documented in ops-runbook-v2
Automated gating will never apply to alerts where error-rate > 0.5% or where SLO breach extrapolation shows > 1 minute to breach if unmitigated
Attach provisional runbook with 'safe-mode' rollback commands, and include a single-click escalation button that tags the incident for human immediate paging

notes: Engineering note (Liam): implemented a lightweight state cache to avoid re-evaluating gating logic for repeated alerts within 5s - reduces CPU in orchestrator
SRE note (Priya): add a post-mortem hook that marks whether an automated hold contributed to a missed SLA - must be stored in incident metadata
Design note (Marco): page payload should include a short summary sentence and two quick links: 'open playbook' and 'suppress for 5m' for mobile responders
communication_plan: Week 0: Announce canary to SRE, Oncall, and Product; link runbook and add training slot
Week 1: Run 10% traffic canary, monitor dashboards daily, weekly sync on Friday
Week 2: Escalate to 30% and then full region if metrics meet criteria; prepare rollback steps and communication templates
postmortem_plan: If a wrongful suppression correlates with SLO breach, open postmortem and roll back gating immediately
Capture timelines, gating decisions, and who overrode hold; update runbooks with learnings
Publish findings to the Reliability guild and adjust severity rescore coefficients
